row.notes: Returns the 200-byte state record for action_id (0..0x26) or the null record 0x146ca69e0. Walks devices at +0x18..+0x20 (filtered by predicate list at +0x58, skipping devices whose +0x1c0 obj has +0x11 set) in four passes, returning the first record whose flag byte +0xc0 has bit 8, then 2, then 0x10, then 1; falls back to FUN_1442dc750 and then a default device scan (stride 0x1e80, largest squared float at +0xc). Callers test +0xc0 bits 1 and 9, so this is the hook point for menu button state.
